opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or research organisation; UK citizens/EEA nationals or doctorate from a UK university; must have completed Viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027; not holding a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to support independent research leading to a significant publishable output.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, based at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation, able to lead interdisciplinary collaborations across the Academies.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for up to 24 months to support interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research that benefits wider society.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers at any career stage based in the UK, working with a GLAM or performing‑arts organisation; must not have received a previous SHAPE award.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects with museums, galleries, libraries, archives or performing‑arts partners.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based postdoctoral or more senior researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or research organisation; must be working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Grants to develop quantitative, data‑science, digital‑humanities or language skills and to foster interdisciplinary methodological innovation.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences, holding a permanent role, collaborating with overseas co‑applicants from any discipline.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary projects on the theme of Mobilities, involving international partners and both SHAPE and STEM disciplines.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences; projects based at DGAP in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships to develop policy‑relevant research and networks across sectors, hosted at DGAP.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support specific additional needs (e.g., equipment, caring costs, accessibility) for applicants or award‑holders.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers based at UK or German institutions in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Travel, accommodation and visa funding for early‑career researchers to attend a three‑day symposium on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’ in April 2027.
